# Second Brain App - Latest Build

## Installation

1. Download the `app-debug.apk` file from the assets below
2. Transfer to your Android phone or tablet
3. Open your file manager and tap the APK file
4. Follow the on-screen prompts to install
5. Grant the requested permissions when prompted

## How to Update

After you install the APK:
- **Web content updates automatically** when you open the app (checks Netlify for new version)
- **No need to reinstall APK** - just open the app and new features load instantly
- **Full offline support** - cached version works without internet

## Features

✨ **Drawing Canvas** - Handwritten lecture notes with shape tools
🔄 **Synchronized Playback** - Audio syncs with your drawings (Samsung Notes style)
📞 **Call Recording Import** - Auto-import and transcribe call recordings (Android only)
🗣️ **Real-time Transcription** - Hebrew language prioritized
📱 **PWA Support** - Install as a native app on any platform
🔌 **External Connections** - Google Drive, Calendar, Notion, Moodle integration

## Troubleshooting

### App Won't Install
- Ensure "Install from unknown sources" is enabled in Settings → Security
- Try a different file manager app

### Permissions Not Working
- Settings → Apps → Second Brain → Permissions
- Enable all requested permissions
- Force stop and restart the app

### Crashes on Startup
- Uninstall and reinstall the APK
- Ensure you have at least 500MB free storage

## Support

If you encounter issues, please let me know and I'll fix them!
